method: Three sequential rounds over the same 44 nonempty fixtures; engine order rotates per fixture and round; meshMs includes tessellation and mesh assembly, excludes parsing, WASM compilation/startup, and output serialization. No peak-memory measurement.
geometryHashMethod: SHA256 of sorted JSON triangle arrays, each preserving exact vertex positions, normals, vertex order and winding. No rounding; only triangle/instance emission order is ignored.
